**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/01 (Wed) 13:33  
[EVENT] User recently bought a new moisturizer and face mask online from Sephora during their 20% off sale.  
[FACT] The moisturizer cost $40 and the face mask cost $20.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for advice on skincare routines.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant congratulated the user on their new skincare purchases and provided tips for incorporating the new moisturizer and face mask into their daily routine.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For the moisturizer, assistant suggested starting with a clean face, applying it immediately after washing while the skin is damp, using a pea-sized amount, massaging it in with upward and outward strokes, and being patient for results.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For the face mask, assistant recommended choosing the right frequency of use (1-3 times a week), prepping the skin by exfoliating 1-2 days before, following the instructions on the packaging, relaxing while the mask is on, and moisturizing afterward.  
[PREFERENCE] User likes the idea of a skincare station.  
[EVENT] User is excited to organize their skincare products in the new InterDesign Linus Skincare Organizer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on how to store skincare products to keep them fresh and organized, especially for small countertop spaces.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended designating a skincare station, using a skincare organizer or tray, utilizing vertical space, storing products by category, keeping products upright, protecting products from light, labeling products, storing in a cool, dry place, keeping expired products out of sight, and cleaning the skincare station regularly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested specific products for skincare organization, including the InterDesign Linus Skincare Organizer, Sorbus Acrylic Skincare Organizer, Simplehuman Rotating Skincare Organizer, and others, along with their approximate prices.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on how to declutter skincare products before organizing them, including taking everything out, sorting products into categories, checking expiration dates, identifying duplicates, considering product condition, keeping only what is used, cleaning products, purging samples, and maintaining organization.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant reiterated the importance of decluttering and suggested revisiting the skincare collection every 3-6 months to maintain organization.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided additional tips for incorporating the new moisturizer and face mask into the user's daily skincare routine, including starting with a clean slate, applying the moisturizer immediately after washing, using the right amount, massaging it in, and being patient for results.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that the user can use the face mask 1-3 times a week, depending on skin type
